summary: This long-form Adobe Photoshop CC tutorial guides advanced masking and selection workflows, weaving together Select Subject, Color Range, Channel Masks, and Focus Area to create complex, non-destructive composites. It demonstrates rapid initial masking with Select Subject, then meticulous refinement in Select & Mask, including Edge Detection, Smart Radius, and Decontaminate Colors. The lesson progresses through several subjects (people and objects), emphasizing techniques to isolate skin, foliage, and colored elements, and extends into color-based masking with Color Range, localized color clusters, and grayscale previews. Practical tips include painting touch-ups with the Brush tool, moving masks between documents and into groups, saving selections, duplicating layers, and building layered shadows for realistic composites. The instructor also shows how to combine multiple techniques non-destructively via adjustment layers and layer masks, and wraps with class projects that reinforce masking and compositing concepts.

sections.title: Video overview and masking targets
sections.description: Introduction to broad masking goals: isolating people, fruit, grass, and sky; preview of techniques (Select Subject, Color Range) and assembling multiple graphics.

sections.title: Exercise files and Subject 1-5 prep
sections.description: Directs the viewer to download exercise files from the course and loads five Subject images to demonstrate progressive difficulty; notes Photoshop version requirements.

sections.title: Subject 1 workflow and initial mask
sections.description: First Subject 1 demonstration: quick selection with Select Subject, add a mask, and review its accuracy; introduces contrast aids (On Black) and keyboard toggles (P) for inspection.

sections.title: Refining with Select & Mask
sections.description: Dives into refining a rough mask using Select & Mask, testing Edge Detection and Smart Radius, and applying Decontaminate Colors to improve edge fidelity.

sections.title: Hair and edge refinements with manual touch-ups
sections.description: Progresses to subjects with hair; uses brushing and targeted refinements, including Alt/Option-assisted precision to fix shoulder/ear hair and refine edges.

sections.title: Mask transfer and duplication tricks
sections.description: Shows how to move masks between documents, duplicate layers, and group multiple masks for consolidated control across a composite.

sections.title: Color Range basics and workflow
sections.description: Introduces Color Range as a color-based selection tool, demonstrates using Sampled Color with fuzziness (100) and the plus/minus approach to isolate subjects, and previews saving selections.

sections.title: Color Range in practice: fruit and background tuning
sections.description: Practical application of Color Range to isolate blues/greens and adjust color with Hue/Saturation and Vibrance on adjustment layers, preserving non-destructive workflows while reframing a scene.

sections.title: Skin tones and color-range caveats
sections.description: Explores Color Range for skin tones (Skin Tones preset), considers detection of faces, and demonstrates targeted touch-ups with brushes to isolate skin while minimizing background bleed.
